title: A Nonrecursive Lindblad Quantization of Dissipative Polynomial Dynamics
summary: We present a direct and nonrecursive construction that maps an arbitrary planar polynomial dissipative flow $\dotα=h(α,α^*)$ to an open quantum system in Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad form. Given the homogeneous components of the classical drift, the corresponding Hamiltonian and collapse-operator blocks are obtained algebraically and independently at each degree.
